orders_update_account.definition: CREATE TRIGGER orders_update_account AFTER INSERT ON public.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.orders_update_account()

public.orders_update_account().definition: CREATE FUNCTION public.orders_update_account() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE public.accounts SET latest_order_id = NEW.id WHERE id = NEW.account_id; RETURN NEW; END $$;
